ResearchTabDef.label: Batshit Technology
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Devices nobody can fully explain and nobody should probably build. Research them at a research bench like anything else.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Batshittium Lore
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn the basics of batshittium, an element that should not exist. A transmogrifier can coax it out of ordinary rock chunks, ten to one.\n\nOpens research into the first batshit devices, and into Batshittium Arcana.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Batshittium Transmogrifier
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the Batshittium Transmogrifier, a powered work table that coaxes batshittium out of ordinary rock chunks, ten to one. Every other batshit device runs on what it makes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Batshittium Reactor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the Batshittium Reactor: 250,000 W while a unit of batshittium burns, for anywhere from minutes to a day and a half, with enough waste heat to cook every room within 12 tiles. It has a self-destruct, and damage can set it off.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Random Replicator
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the Random Replicator, which conjures a random meal or raw food every six hours into a refrigerated compartment for haulers to empty. It has a self-destruct, and damage can set it off.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Brain Squeezer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the Brain Squeezer, a chair that squeezes a colonist's brain for moderate recreation and leaves them calmer for a day, if slightly rearranged.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Batshittium Arcana
ResearchProjectDef.description: Delve past the lore into the arcana of batshittium: the deeper, less advisable applications of an element that should not exist.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Painful Bolts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Teach the Batshittium Artificer to make Painful bolts: kinetic Ballista ammunition, ten from each unit of batshittium.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Really Painful Bolts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Teach the Batshittium Artificer to make Really Painful bolts: explosive Ballista ammunition, five from each unit of batshittium.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Batshittium Artificer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the Batshittium Artificer, an automated workshop that turns batshittium into Ballista bolts with no one at the controls.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ballista Magazine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build Ballista Magazines: 2,560 bolts each, feeding any Ballista they touch, directly or through a chain of other magazines.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Batshit Ballista
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the Batshit Ballista: volleys of up to 256 bolts, up to 325 tiles away, once every five seconds. Insanely inaccurate, terrifyingly destructive, and hungry for power.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ergonomic Singularity Grenade
ResearchProjectDef.description: Teach the Batshittium Artificer to make Ergonomic Singularity Grenades: one per unit of batshittium. Thrown, each opens a singularity that drags everything within 10 tiles together for five seconds and then explodes. Survivors rave about the comfort.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Tractor Bomb
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Build the Tractor Barn, which builds Tractor Bombs by itself: little steel farm tractors that patrol for hostiles, drive at the nearest one they can see, and plant themselves. Each then drags everything within 22.5 tiles into a heap at its feet and explodes over 7.5 tiles. Sixty steel, three components and five batshittium apiece, carried in by haulers; the barn also patches up the ones that limp home.
A colonist or guest inside the tractor beam earns a three-second protest, after which the bomb emplaces anyway. Keep colonists and guests out of the beam.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Tractor Bomb Dial-A-Yield
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Fit every Tractor Bomb with two more dials, each with three settings: its tractor beam, Intimate (9 tiles), Neighborly (22.5) or Popular (33.75), and its blast, Birthday Cake (3 tiles), Firework (7.5) or Block Party (12). Set them on a robot, on a planted bomb until it starts to pull, or on the Tractor Barn for every robot it builds. They leave the factory at Neighborly and Firework.
None of the settings is safe.
